ACCESS_TOKEN.description: A password you invent. It goes in the relay URL you paste into the app. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 16`.

TURN_KEY_ID.description: The TURN key id from [Realtime > TURN Keys](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/realtime/turn) in your dashboard.

TURN_KEY_API_TOKEN.description: The API token shown next to that TURN key. Cloudflare shows it once, so copy it when you create the key.
